mapper.select: SELECT LGN_ATMPT_LMT_SN , LGN_ID_HMAC , CNTNU_CERT_FAIL_NMTM , SCRTY_CD_HASH , SCRTY_CD_RQT_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM LGN_ATMPT_LMT WHERE LGN_ID_HMAC = #{lgnIdHmac}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LGN_ATMPT_LMT ( LGN_ID_HMAC , CNTNU_CERT_FAIL_NMTM , SCRTY_CD_HASH , SCRTY_CD_RQT_YN ) VALUES ( #{lgnIdHmac} , 1 , NULL , IF(1 >= #{failLimit}, 'Y', 'N') ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CNTNU_CERT_FAIL_NMTM = CNTNU_CERT_FAIL_NMTM + 1 , SCRTY_CD_RQT_YN = IF(CNTNU_CERT_FAIL_NMTM >= #{failLimit}, 'Y', SCRTY_CD_RQT_YN) , SCRTY_CD_HASH = NULL , MDFCN_DT = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE LGN_ATMPT_LMT SET SCRTY_CD_HASH = NULL , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE LGN_ID_HMAC = #{lgnIdHmac}
